def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def rel(p):return str(p.relative_to(root)).replace("\\","/")
def save(name,x):
    p=out/name

    p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def git(*args):return subprocess.run(["git",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",check=True).stdout
result_path=out/"result.json"; result=read(result_path)
assert sha(result_path.read_bytes())=="c99e73b1a3849926a698a2e4c891260c50e8975811f1049c692684695599a904"
assert (result["actual_counts"]["fixed_cases"],result["actual_counts"]["complete_quantity_sources"],result["actual_counts"]["own_quantity_clocks"])==(3,3,2)

assert sha(report_path.read_bytes())==result["artifacts"]["report"]["sha256"]

initial=read(out/"运行前git记录_E114.json")
if status!=initial["tracked_status"] or branch!=initial["branch"] or head!=initial["HEAD"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Git权威状态已有外部变化，停止不覆盖")
paths=[root/"docs/PROJECT_STATE.md",root/"docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md",root/"config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json",root/"config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json"]
before={p:p.read_bytes() for p in paths}; texts={p:raw.decode("utf-8-sig") for p,raw in before.items()}
snapshot=out/"长期事实写入前快照_E114"
if snapshot.exists():raise RuntimeError("事实更新已执行")
snapshot.mkdir()
for p,raw in before.items():(snapshot/p.name).write_bytes(raw)
at=now()
